title: Hope Bancorp Reports Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Six Months Ended June 30, 2026
summary: Second quarter 2026 net income of $33.0 million, up 12% quarter-over-quarter Hope Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: HOPE), the holding company of Bank of Hope (the “Bank”), today reported unaudited financial results for its second quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026. For the second quarter of 2026, the Company reported net income of $33.0 million, or $0.26 per diluted common share, up 12% from net income of $29.5 million, or $0.23 per diluted common share, for the first quarter of 2026, and up from a net loss of $24.8 million, or $(0.19) per diluted common share, for the second quarter of 2025.
